about_the_game:
Deckheim is a roguelike deckbuilder where ancient runes meet tactical combat. Forge your own path through a mythic world inspired by Norse legend, building a deck of powerful spells, summons, and relics as you battle gods, monsters, and rival heroes. Every run offers new choices, new synergies, and new challenges—no two journeys through Deckheim are ever the same.

Customize Each Run

Begin your journey in Deckheim by tailoring each run to your playstyle. Choose your starting bonuses, unlock new cards, and plan your route through branching paths. Whether you seek power, risk, or strategy, the map lets you forge your own fate.

Build your deck with a variety of summon cards, spell cards, hero upgrades, and passive Runic Treasures. Each run features a unique combination of tools, including a customizable Hero with a powerful ability to define your strategy.

Face Unique Foes

Combat plays out on a dynamic 2D board, blending the tactical depth of traditional trading card games with fast-paced roguelike decision-making.

Encounter a wide range of opponents—some appear as relentless waves of summoned enemies, others as rival AI-controlled heroes with their own decks and abilities. Prepare for everything from skirmishes to brutal minibosses and epic boss battles.

Rooted in Norse Mythology

Explore a world steeped in the myths and legends of Norse folklore. From divine relics to monstrous adversaries, every element of Deckheim draws inspiration from ancient sagas. Survive the trials of Midgard, uncover forgotten runes, and prove your worth in a realm where fate favors the bold.
